[quote=alkiragunya;59338133]Warra sorri em resposta, e o grupo estrangeiro é bem vindo na caravana, ao longo das noites os Alkiragunyan, com a ajuda de Olaf, Tau e os outros eles criavam alguns abrigos temporários, uns Gunyas, e coletavam água de soakages ou então de cascas de árvores na umidade noturna, se alimentando de lagartos e frutas, após 4 dias, eles chegam ao Oásis Towurunga.
[i]E aqui nos despedimos[/i]
Warra diz se virando a Tau e então desaparecendo em uma multidão de vários outros Alkiragunyans, o Oásis tinha vários Gunyas, todos eram essencialmente idênticos, semi-ciculares, mantidos por gravetos e galhos, cobertos por grama, e uma cortina de folhas na entrada, havia uma exceção no entanto, uma espécie de templo de pedra,com vários aborígenes orando, e um outro Gunya, com 12 homens velhos sentados em roda, o chão desse Gunya ao contrário de outros, era de couro, e na entrada havia um homem, com vestes comuns semelhantes a de quaisquer outro, só se diferenciava por ter uma máscara, e sua altura elevada, semelhante a de Trym, ele segura um cajado de madeira velho, e acena para o grupo, como se os  convidasse para algo.
[i]Bem vindos, Tau, Trym, Olaf e Djalu, as notícias se espalham como as areias do deserto em tempestade, muito rápido, já sabemos de vocês e estávamos os aguardando, faz muito tempo desde a última vinda de estrangeiros até aqui.[/i]
Warra smiles in response, and the foreign group is welcomed into the caravan. Over the course of the nights, the Alkiragunyan, with the help of Olaf, Tau and the others, created some temporary shelters, some Gunyas, and collected water from soakages or from tree bark in the nighttime humidity, feeding on lizards and fruits. After 4 days, they arrived at the Towurunga Oasis. And here we say goodbye
Warra says turning to Tau and then disappearing into a crowd of several other Alkiragunyans, the Oasis had several Gunyas, all of them were essentially identical, semi-circular, held together by twigs and branches, covered by grass, and a curtain of leaves at the entrance, there was one exception however, a kind of stone temple, with several aborigines praying, and another Gunya, with 12 old men sitting in a circle, the floor of this Gunya unlike others, was made of leather, and at the entrance there was a man, with common clothes similar to any other, he was only different because he had a mask, and his tall height, similar to Trym's, he holds an old wooden staff, and waves to the group, as if inviting them to something. 
[i]Welcome, Tau, Trym, Olaf and Djalu, news spreads like the sands of the desert in a storm, very fast, we already know about you and we were waiting for you, it has been a long time since the last arrival of foreigners here.[/i][/quote]

The four Nordiheimians approaches the Gunya that has the masked man at its entrance, with Tau in the front, they give thanks for the welcome and graciously accept the invitation.
Tau speaks to introduce himself and his group when they are close enough for the elders to hear them clearly.
[i]I feal like I am not wrong in assuming that you elders are the council of Alkiragunya that we have heard about[/i]
He motions to his 3 companions in turn as they each gives a respectfull greeting to the council [i]These are my companions Olaf, Trym and Djalu[/i]
Tau then gives a greeting of his own [i]And I are Tau, we are travelers from the nation of Nordiheim that have traveled far to meet you, to talk about the potential of trade between our peoples, but also to broaden our understanding of your people as we have realiced that we actualy know less about your people and your ways then we feel we should[/i]
